faqs.q: Do I need to be technical?
faqs.a: No. We cover AI for all levels — non-tech (prompting/cost) through to engineering (RAG/MCP). Pick your path.
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, local models (Ollama). We show you how to use each and when.

faqs.q: How do I pay less for AI?
faqs.a: Week 3–4 covers exactly this: free tiers, model switching, prompt compression, and API cost hacks.
4–6 hrs/wk. Videos + guided project time. Work at your own pace.
